BackstoryDef.title: ai persona
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is an ai persona. [PAWN_pronoun] was built to manage an estate or ship and can only physically interact with the world through remotely piloted robots.

BackstoryDef.title: ai subpersona
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] is an ai subpersona. [PAWN_pronoun] was created by mapping the brains of several humans to form a fascimile of the human mind. Not as powerful as a full AI Persona, [PAWN_nameDef] was created for a specific job instead of general autonomy.
